TO REFRESH OR NOT TO REFRESH  

The hot topic coming into this mint is whether or not you will have to refresh our mint page to reveal the “enter queue” or “mint” buttons. The simple answer is: NO. Once you have connected your wallet to our mint site you should see a countdown in yellow. Once the countdown ends, the page will auto refresh and you should now have a “mint” or “enter queue” button. The page refresh time will vary for most depending on internet speed. If you are dealing with a less than desirable internet connection and the page seems “stuck”, you may refresh the page.   

To address the queue positions and refreshing…  When we begin the sale, we will slowly be opening the “faucet” to allow individuals to mint. At first, your queue position will move very slowly. As we open the “faucet” and begin to allow more and more minting to take place, your position should start to update quicker. If you are convinced that your queue position is “stuck” you are free to refresh your page. Your position is connected to your wallet, not the browser.

While we've resolved previous minting issues, the incredibly high demand for Cornucopias NFTs created a whole new set of problems. 

The Cornucopias Team and our technology partners worked intensely throughout the mint to resolve these new issues. Unfortunately, our troubleshooting efforts kept everyone waiting.

We’ve decided to gift a FREE NFT to everyone who was in queue for the sale but was unable to mint. If this was your experience, you will receive a free GTI Javelin on behalf of the Cornucopias team. 

In order to accomplish this, we're increasing the amount of NFTs minted to match the number of people who were in the queue. 12,400 wallets will receive a free GTI Javelin. Your NFT will be automatically delivered to the wallet used during the sale. You do not have to take any actions. 

Five lucky people were able to mint, and they will get a full refund of the 95 ADA purchase price.

Retaining the trust and support of our community is the most crucial goal for the project as we build out the game.

Getting these NFTs to you is our and Derp's highest priority. We will update you as soon as they will become available. Thank you once again for your patience.
